We still want to evaluate Redwood, just want to be honest about timing — this will be deprioritized against a platform delivery for Q4. If you have a 1-pager or short tech brief, please send it and we can keep it with our notes.

Samir

I'll mark the opportunity as "paused" in HubSpot and tag it for a January re-engagement unless you prefer another cadence. Attaching a one-pager now.
